name: A shared replay link survives sign-in
description: A signed-out reader opens a deep link to a replay minute and view, is sent to sign in, and comes back to that exact link with its moment restored.

planSteps.description: Assert the URL path is /sign-in and its query has next=/cases/eagle-s-2024?t=2024-12-25T16:44Z&view=closeup (URL-encoded)
In the sign-in form (data-testid account-form), type testsprite@example.com in the Email field and cabletrace-testsprite-2026 in the Password field, then click Sign in

Assert that within 30 seconds the URL path is /cases/eagle-s-2024 with t=2024-12-25T16:44Z and view=closeup in its query, the replay console (data-testid replay-console) is shown, and the clock reads 16:44
